$comment: Which STUDIES the README's results section and the charts may draw from. Keys are study ids as recorded in bench/manifest.json - the published record - not working-directory tags, because every published number must be derivable from committed data. Everything in bench/raw/ is published; this file decides what counts as a HEADLINE claim. One batch is not enough: the bar set in Amendment 3 is the direction repeating across independent batches, and the effect published is the range across them.

excluded.retracted-partB2-body-length: RETRACTED: same defect - 0 of 10 skill runs read the body.
